cohort: 1302 primiparous women with a second stage duration of ≥3 h, delivering from December 2017 to November 2018 in Stockholm, Sweden
finding: The risk of pelvic floor dysfunction was increased after vacuum extraction at both 3-4 hours and 4-5 hours compared to expectant management, but remained unchanged after caesarean section.
mod_finding: The risk of pelvic floor dysfunction increased after vacuum extraction but was unaffected by CS, compared with expectant management.
